gaps.sentence: He is very ___ to criticism and takes it personally.
gaps.hint: easily affected or hurt; pattern: ___ to
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to something' means easily affected or upset by it; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: Factory workers are paid ___ at the end of each week.
gaps.hint: pay for manual work, usually weekly
gaps.explanation: 'Wages' are paid weekly, often in cash, for manual or unskilled work; salaries are monthly.

gaps.sentence: The committee acted on legal ___ before revising the clause.
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is the noun; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: Please be ___ — the baby is sleeping.
gaps.explanation: 'Quiet' means making little or no noise; 'quite' is an adverb meaning fairly or completely.

gaps.sentence: This small car is very ___ to run.
gaps.explanation: 'Economical' means costing little or saving money; 'economic' relates to trade, industry or the economy.

gaps.sentence: My brother is six foot three — he is much ___ than me.
gaps.explanation: 'Tall' is used for people's height, so the comparative is 'taller'; 'higher' is for heights above a level.

gaps.sentence: The consultant will ___ us on every stage of the merger.
gaps.explanation: 'Advise' is the verb; 'advice' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: One of the screws on the bracket has come ___.
